desc: Classic street lamp with warm glow
code: const s=ctx.scale||1; const x=ctx.x||0; const y=ctx.y||0; const lit=ctx.lit!==false; svg += `<g transform="translate(${x},${y}) scale(${s})">`; svg += `<line x1="0" y1="15" x2="0" y2="-30" stroke="#3A3A3A" stroke-width="2.5"/>`; svg += `<path d="M0 -30 Q8 -32 10 -28" fill="none" stroke="#3A3A3A" stroke-width="2"/>`; if(lit){ const glow = isN ? 0.6 : 0.15; svg += `<circle cx="10" cy="-26" r="4" fill="#FFE088" opacity="${glow}"/>`; if(isN) svg += `<circle cx="10" cy="-26" r="20" fill="#FFE088" opacity="0.04"/>`; } else { svg += `<circle cx="10" cy="-26" r="4" fill="#555"/>`; } svg += `</g>`; return svg;
